16/*
17命名规则：
181.我去掉了原模版类中的<>，将原来模版类中的类型名称直接加在后面作为新结构体的名称
192.有重名的类我在前面加入了A
203.可能的隐患:<windows*>我改为了windows，而游戏原来也存在<windows>
21Naming Rules:
221.I removed the <>from the original template class and appended the original template parameter type name directly to form the new structure's name.
232.For classes with duplicate names, I prefixed them with an 'A'.
243.Potential risk: <windows*>was changed to 'windows', while the original game code also had a <windows>.
25*/
